A great yard isn't decorated. It's designed — then built to hold up.

Heritage Design Group is a Smithtown-based landscape design-build studio. We take on the whole arc of a project — front walkways, patios, pool-area landscaping and full yard transformations — for homeowners across Long Island's North Shore.

We start with a design: how the space should flow, where the stone and plantings sit, how it will look once it settles in. Then we build it, and stay with it from the first drawing to the final touches — the reason our clients keep rating the work a clean 5.0.

How we work

Design first, build second, site left clean.

A clear path from the first look at your property to the day you start using the space.

Walk the property

We come look at the space, talk through what you're picturing, and figure out how the hardscape, plantings and grade should work together.

Design it on paper

You see the plan before a shovel goes in — layout, materials and plantings laid out so you know exactly what you're getting.

Build it by hand

We build the whole thing — patio, walls, walkways and plantings — on a proper base, from the design stage to the final touches.

Walk it back

We finish the details, clean the site down, and hand back a yard that's ready to live in and built to last.

What we build

One studio, the whole project.

Design and build under one roof — from a front walkway to a full pool-area transformation. The same people who design your yard are the ones who build it.
